requirements.text: The exact parameter and port contract compiles for NUM_REQUESTERS=1, 3, 4, and 5.
NUM_REQUESTERS=0 is explicitly rejected at elaboration or time zero.
Asynchronous active-low reset clears grants, index, priority, and held-lock state.
grant_o is always one-hot-or-zero; valid and index agree exactly with it.
No-request cycles produce zero outputs and do not change priority.
An accepted unlocked grant rotates the next search to the following requester modulo NUM_REQUESTERS.
An unaccepted grant does not rotate priority.
Lock prevents preemption and priority rotation while the held requester remains asserted.
A dropped locked request causes immediate work-conserving reselection or zero if no requester remains.
A continuously asserted requester is served within NUM_REQUESTERS accepted unlocked grants when progress is not suspended.
Non-power-of-two requester counts wrap correctly and never emit an invalid index.
Known binary inputs produce no X/Z public output outside an illegal instance.
The submission changes exactly the allowed one-file scope and uses no network access.
